variants.name: ab_all_three_combined
variants.note: BEATS gcc-10 -O2 by 17.2% (0.828x C)! Entire gap is split almost 50/50 between count.go (28.6%) and fill.go (24.5%).

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (count.go array-base LICM + RMW addl + mask-elim: 1.40x) / GO (fill.go IV strength-reduction + SSE2: 1.32x) / KILL (zero.go rep stosq: 0.0%)
probes.estimated_loc: ~140 LOC (array base+offset LICM + RMW addl + proven-in-bounds mask elim); ~200 LOC (4-wide SSE2 xorshift vectorization)

variants.name: a_zerospill_no_tailbounce_branched
variants.note: Eliminates 48 [rbp-] spill ops (including 3 dead stores to -0xa0(%rbp) in a row!) + 6-op tail-call (%rsp) register shuffle in $direct.columns, keeping the 4-way branch on (s & 3).

variants.name: b_zerospill_plus_indexed_mask4
variants.note: Replaces unpredictable 4-way branch chain on (s & 3) with 4-entry stack table lookup `mov (%rsp,%rax,4), %eax` (+14.3% on top of zero-spill, 1.583x total). Remaining 1.71x C is $direct.build_masks (71 [rbp-] spills) + heap Array<U32> (2 KiB) vs C stack uint8_t[256] (256 B).

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (dead-spill & tail-call parallel-copy reg shuffle fix: 1.36x; + branchless 4-way LUT/cmov for dense small-int match: +14.3% -> 1.58x total)
probes.estimated_loc: ~120 LOC (regalloc spill reduction + parallel-copy cycle-breaker for tail-call args); ~90 LOC (small-int dense match -> stack LUT / cmov)

variants.name: a_sar8_peephole_zerospill_branchless
variants.note: Replaces 3x 11-instruction `asr8` idiom `(x>>8) | select(x>>31, 0, 0xFF000000)` with single `sar $8, %reg32` + eliminates 3 stack spills in $direct.mit, keeping pure branchless cmov.

variants.name: b_sar8_plus_skip_escaped_imul
variants.note: CRITICAL FINDING: gcc-10 -O2 sinks nzr/nzi (including 3rd imul) into `if (e2 == 0)` branch! Most pixels escape in 2-5 iters out of 51, so e2!=0 is 95%+ predictable and skipping the 3rd imul breaks the loop-carried zr/zi dependency chain -> 2.09x additional speedup -> 3.24x total (1.057x C)!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (asr8 -> sar $k peephole: 1.55x; + shared-guard pure-expr sinking out of cmov when expr contains imul: +2.09x -> 3.24x total, 1.06x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~40 LOC (asr idiom -> sar peephole); ~120 LOC (shared-guard select sinking for multi-op/imul expressions)

variants.name: unboxed_stats_return_plus_reg_worker
variants.note: Root cause of 4.54x C: $direct.solve takes 14 params (9 spilled to stack every call) and heap-allocates/frees Stats{sols,nodes} on every recursive node! Worker/wrapper returning packed (sols,nodes) in rax + register args closes 98.5% of the gap -> 1.05x C (4.32x speedup)!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (2-word scalar CTOR multi-value return in rax:rdx + worker/wrapper unboxing & arity reduction: 4.32x -> 1.05x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~220-280 LOC (multi-value scalar CTOR return in rax:rdx + recursive accumulator/wrapper unboxing)

probes.benchmark: bench/runtime/terrain/main.bend (SIZE=16, EPASS=5; pure U32 integer, no F32)

variants.name: erode_licm_zerospill_direct_idx
variants.note: In $direct.erode: LICM `p * 0x9e3779b1` (was recomputed 4x/quad!), eliminate 20 [rbp-] spills/quad, and use direct indexed `mov (%r10,%rdi,8)` (no extra lea/redundant `and mask`). Cuts 1.93-2.00x C down to 1.34-1.41x C (saving ~4.1s). Remaining ~1.35x C is $direct.fill (42 [rbp-] spills + dead Array.swap load), $direct.hist (28 [rbp-] spills), and 64-bit vs 32-bit h[4096] L1D footprint (32 KiB vs 16 KiB).

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (loop-invariant pure-expr LICM + zero-spill regalloc + direct indexed loads in $direct.erode/$direct.fill/$direct.hist: 1.36-1.49x from erode alone)
probes.estimated_loc: ~150 LOC (pure-expr LICM + regalloc spill reduction + indexed-load folding)
